item.title: Trump announces White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt stepping down
item.description: She will leave her role at the end of the month, Trump said.

item.title: Mission Improbable: Onetime Republican trying to prove Democrats can win in Florida
item.description: David Jolly, a former Republican now running for Florida governor as a Democrat, aims to revive the state's battleground status.

item.title: Tehran says Strait of Hormuz "under Iran's control" after Trump threat
item.description: Tehran asserts control over the Strait of Hormuz after Trump suggested the U.S. might "keep it."

item.title: Sevastopol blast kills Russian service member, state media says
item.description: An explosion in Sevastopol killed a Russian service member on Thursday, according to state-run RIA Novosti.
